about: GMDSS high-seas forecast SUB-AREAS whose limits the issuing service states as latitudes and longitudes in its own broadcast bulletin (facts, typed in 2026-11-02 from the bulletin sets WMO WWMIWS serves at wwmiws.wmo.int/index.php/metareas/bulletinset_download/<METAREA>/txt; BoM's from ftp.bom.gov.au/anon/gen/fwo/IDY10210.txt). Each 'def' is the bulletin's own words. 'box' = [south, north, west, east] in degrees (E positive; a box across 180° gives east > 180). 'ring' = corner points [lon, lat] in order. 'coast': consecutive corners on the same land follow Natural Earth's coastline between them (the UK method). Left out (and why) in gen-sea-areas.mjs: an area bounded by 'the ice edge', by an unnamed coast ('WEST COAST', 'EAST COAST'), or a box the bulletin gives over a continent without saying where the coast cuts it.
